# ADA Psykiatriens Hus Aarhus

ADA Psykiatriens Hus Aarhus is a clinical unit named in the ADHD-databasen (the Danish ADHD quality database) 2024 report, in the section covering Indikator 10 [^src1][^src2]. Indikator 10 measures the proportion of adult treatment courses in which the patient's need for social support was assessed no later than 120 days after treatment start, and the report explains this was the first time the indicator had been reported at all, with national fulfillment at only 37% and regional results ranging from 14% to 52% against a 90% quality target [^src1].

Against that backdrop of widespread underperformance, ADA Psykiatriens Hus Aarhus stands out for reporting 100% fulfillment of Indikator 10 [^src1][^src2]. However, the figure comes with an important caveat: the underlying case count is very small, expressed in the report as a range of "3-100" [^src1][^src2], meaning the 100% result is based on as few as three treatment courses. This makes the result statistically fragile compared to units reporting on larger caseloads, a point that fits the broader discussion in the source document, where the steering group ("Styregruppen") debated the causes of low indicator fulfillment nationally, pointing to registration practices and data quality issues in child- and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinics and private hospitals, and resolved to work on improving registration practice [^src1].

No relationships or additional claims beyond the two indicator mentions are documented for this entity in the corpus.
